amendments.what: CEM also evaluates its final mean and returns the better of it and the best sample
amendments.why: the final mean is CEM's estimate of the solution; the 95% DI gate is unchanged

amendments.what: PushT segment continuation: max_k (d_k - d_0) <= 1.0 px, d_0 the terminal miss
amendments.why: an absolute 1.0 px rule is stricter than the terminal tolerance epsilon = 2.870 px; the drift rule tests divergence after rejoining

amendments.what: continuation-consistent recovery (CCIL #171, 2026-11-18): W, psi, L = W - 1 handoff actions, endpoint and handoff residuals as separate constraints; PushT W = 2, L = 1; DI and Pendulum W = 1, L = 0 (unchanged); M = 1 is ruled out only if no M = 1 action passes endpoint and handoff
amendments.why: endpoint agreement alone does not restore a two-frame policy's information state

problem.segment: single-shooting rollout under the reference map
problem.target: y_M = x_(t+M) of the anchor's episode
valid: refined replay within epsilon where applicable
PushT: continuation check (8 recorded actions within 1.0 px)
problem.targets: current state only; observation history is kept in the artifact, not in the reach condition

anchor_rule.pusht: t >= 1, t + 16 + 8 inside the episode, anchor row replay-verified (#52 B0)

availability.invalid_draw: outside the state envelope; PushT also penetration or bisection failure
availability.exhausted: start unavailable: recorded, never solved, in no denominator, never M = 1-infeasible

oracle.method: scipy.optimize.lsq_linear in U; reachable if optimum <= 0.9 epsilon

m1_infeasibility.rule: min_grid d_refined - L_u*h/2 - 2*delta > epsilon; L_u = dt*exp(sqrt(1+g^2)*dt); delta = max grid |evaluator - refined|

pusht.map: gym_pusht (LeRobot 0.6.1 env), action interval 0.1 s, physics dt 0.01
pusht.metric: largest per-point distance over the current frame's agent and 8 T keypoints, px (oracle_probe.distance)

information_state.handoff_metric: max over the window of the per-frame metric: max(d(x_M, y_M), d(x_(M+1), y_(M+1)))
information_state.audit: the 8-action continuation drift, independent of the optimizer

pusht.state_envelope: agent and T center in [0, 512]^2; no penetration (simulator)
pusht.perturbation: agent (x, y) and T (x, y, theta) along a uniform direction, bisected to the radius; velocities kept

m1_infeasibility.rule: no grid action u, followed by the handoff action a_(t+1), has handoff residual within 2 epsilon (amendment 3); the endpoint-only minimum is recorded

pusht.tau_rule: #52 B0's rule on the 9 current-frame points; B0's 29.764080044321236 px was on 18 points

continuation.eligibility: anchor's replay-reconstructed state restored fresh; recorded a_t..a_(t+M+7) keep rows t+1..t+M+8 within 1.0 px, else the anchor-M pair is ineligible (in no denominator)
continuation.segment: same live space; recorded a_(t+M)..a_(t+M+7) from x_M give d_k to rows t+M+1..t+M+8 with max_k (d_k - d_0) <= 1.0 px, d_0 the terminal miss (amendment 2)

cem.returns: the better of the best sample over all iterations and the final mean clipped to bounds; a tie keeps the sample (amendment 1)

measures: unavailable starts and redraws by system x radius; PushT ineligible anchor-M pairs
valid yield by system x radius x M
ambiguity: distinct valid solutions (RMS action difference > 0.05 ubar) and ties within 1e-9
DI recall per solver and M, and every rejected returned segment
DI and Pendulum demonstrated-action replay miss per anchor-M pair

unsolved eligible pairs per solver and M by the best returned candidate: no returned endpoint-feasible candidate, handoff miss, constraint violation, continuation failure, or no candidate returned; observed solver outcomes, not proofs of infeasibility; optimizer adequacy is calibrated on DI only

double_integrator.recall_population: M > 1 cases with oracle optimum <= 0.9 epsilon
double_integrator.cem_fails_only: PushT verdict: solver-inconclusive, not evidence that recovery is impossible

treatment.population: available starts with M = 1 ruled out by the same validity predicate as M > 1 (endpoint and handoff; Pendulum Lipschitz-certified, PushT conservative empirical sweep); V counts valid segments at eligible M > 1, each passing replay, constraints, endpoint, handoff, refinement and the continuation audit

decision.stage_2_passes: DI passes and at least one of Pendulum or PushT passes
decision.after: Stage 3 only for passing systems; no treatment pass ends #171 before Stage 3
decision.pusht_certificate: conservative empirical evidence, not an exact certificate (no bound closes the 2 px grid gaps); if PushT alone passes, the user decides whether it suffices before Stage 3
decision.denominators: available starts and, on PushT, eligible pairs only (DI recall included)

smoke.cost_projection: complete path for every system: availability, eligibility, M = 1 certificate, every M, every restart, all checks
